finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite atlas for Dream Town. Match existing cozy painterly isometric town art: creamy plaster, terracotta roofs, dark oak, jewel green foliage, soft sunlight from upper left, polished hand painted 3D illustration, crisp readable silhouettes. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 sprites in strict row-major order. Equal sized cells, each subject centered, at least 15 percent empty padding on EVERY side inside every cell. No sprite crosses its cell. Row 1: charming steam locomotive facing lower left; matching cargo rail wagon facing lower left; small red roof railway station; vintage propeller cargo airplane facing lower left. Row 2: small airfield hangar and control hut; wooden cargo harbor with crane; cargo sailing ship facing lower left; small fishing boat facing lower left. Row 3: tropical island with palm trees and small dock; two coconuts one open; ripe pineapple; open shell holding pearl. Genuinely transparent alpha background and gutters. No checkerboard, solid background, captions, typography, watermarks or grid lines. No extra sprites. Whole subjects, no clipping. Buildings on small individual isometric grass/stone foundations. Aim for 2048px wide high quality sheet.
